00082 UGenArray::UGenArray(UGenArray const& array0, UGenArray const& array1, const bool removeNulls) throw()
00083 :   internal(0)
00084 {
00085     if(removeNulls == false)
00086     {
00087         int newSize = array0.size() + array1.size();
00088         
00089         if(newSize != 0) {
00090             internal = new UGenArrayInternal(newSize);
00091             
00092             int newIndex = 0;
00093             
00094             for(int i = 0; i < array0.size(); i++) {
00095                 internal->array[newIndex++] = array0.internal->array[i];
00096             }
00097             
00098             for(int i = 0; i < array1.size(); i++) {
00099                 internal->array[newIndex++] = array1.internal->array[i];
00100             }
00101         }
00102     }
00103     else
00104     {   
00105         int newSize = array0.sizeNotNull() + array1.sizeNotNull();
00106         
00107         if(newSize != 0) {
00108             internal = new UGenArrayInternal(newSize);
00109             
00110             int newIndex = 0;
00111             
00112             for(int i = 0; i < array0.size(); i++) {
00113                 if(array0.internal->array[i].isNotNull())
00114                     internal->array[newIndex++] = array0.internal->array[i];
00115             }
00116             
00117             for(int i = 0; i < array1.size(); i++) {
00118                 if(array1.internal->array[i].isNotNull())
00119                     internal->array[newIndex++] = array1.internal->array[i];
00120             }
00121         }
00122     }

00213 int UGenArray::findMaxNumChannels() const throw()
00214 {
00215     if(internal == 0) return 0;
00216         
00217     int maxNumChannels = 0;
00218     
00219     for(int i = 0; i < internal->size_; i++)
00220     {
00221         int numChannels = internal->array[i].getNumChannels();
00222         maxNumChannels = numChannels > maxNumChannels ? numChannels : maxNumChannels;
00223     }
00224     
00225     return maxNumChannels;
00226 }

00379 UGenArray UGenArray::range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
00380 {
00381     if(internal == 0) return UGenArray();
00382     
00383     const int startIndexChecked = clip(startIndex, 0, internal->size_);
00384     const int endIndexChecked = clip(endIndex, 0, internal->size_);
00385     
00386     const int size = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
00387     
00388     if(size <= 0)
00389         return UGenArray();
00390     else
00391     {
00392         UGenArray newArray(size);
00393         
00394         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00395         {
00396             newArray.put(i, at(i + startIndexChecked));
00397         }
00398         
00399         return newArray;
00400     }
00401 }

00424     {

00470 UGenArray UGenArray::interleave() const throw()
